# CFR Java decompiler

RepoDesk bundles the unmodified CFR 0.152 release to display Java class differences in Git history.
It runs with the Java runtime already bundled for Java language support.

- Project: https://www.benf.org/other/cfr/
- Release: https://github.com/leibnitz27/cfr/releases/tag/0.152
- Artifact: https://www.benf.org/other/cfr/cfr-0.152.jar
- Artifact SHA-256: `f686e8f3ded377d7bc87d216a90e9e9512df4156e75b06c655a16648ae8765b2`
- License: MIT, included in `CFR-LICENSE.txt` in the source tree and `LICENSE.txt` beside the bundled JAR.
- Original license: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leibnitz27/cfr/0.152/LICENSE

Decompiled text may differ from original source code. CFR's own project guidance asks users to decompile only class files they have the legal right to inspect.
